gaps.explanation: Statement p5 Transfers from (to) other funds: General 265,544, Street 256,877, Sales Tax (305,837), Debt Service (195,886), Other Governmental Funds (Lottery Fund) (46,168), Total Governmental Funds (25,470). The JSON statement transfers_out is the Total column's net (25,470). Detail transfers out = Sales Tax -305,837 (p11) only. Part 1 (missing fund column): the Debt Service (195,886) and Lottery Fund (46,168) transfers out have no schedule; added from p5, detail transfers out becomes 305,837 + 195,886 + 46,168 = 547,891 (gross). Part 2 (different basis): the Total column nets gross transfers out 547,891 against gross transfers in 522,421 (General 265,544 + Street 256,877, both already in detail as Transfers In): 547,891 - 522,421 = 25,470. Remaining difference after the fix: 25,470 - 547,891 = -522,421 = the governmental transfers in netted by the statement; not an error.
